items.title: Joseph Ralph Robinson Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: Oh, they want me to go with them, I... Sometime I duck them, they say, I'm coming at you tomorrow night.

ctx.x: I didn't think who it would be then.

And so they wanted me to go away with them. I told them, no, I couldn't leave here. Sometimes I had to duck from them, you know. They come for me to play in different place with them, you know. It wouldn't have been Kid Rene. I believe that's the word, yeah, Kid? Kid Rene? That's the word. Because he was fairly light, I remember. Yeah, Kid Rene is right. I think it was fairly light. Oh, they want me to go with them, I... Sometime I duck them, they say, I'm coming at you tomorrow night. I say, okay. Yeah. They…
They want you to play your clarinet? Play with them, yes.
